description: This PHP source file provides the backend and frontend code for the 'Voip_SipBasic_ServiceProvider' configuration page in a network device web interface. It includes PHP logic for defining and fetching SIP configuration data, embedded HTML for the form, and JavaScript to handle UI interaction, form population, and AJAX calls to update or control SIP settings.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Fetches various SIP configuration values from the device through the getStr() function, returning them as an associative array.
